notes.title: Conflux Playtest v0.1.2
notes.content:
- You can now randomize your appearance in the character creator with a newly added button.
- Outdoor areas now have improved lighting and softer shadows.
- Added an autosave feature. The game should now save to the autosave slot any time you enter an overworld map.
- Added a help menu which explains game mechanics and the UI to players. You can click the question mark icon in the bottom left or either press "H" or "F1" your keyboard to open it.
- The quest journal should now automatically scroll down to the most recent entry at the bottom.
- When you are defeated there's now a button that loads the latest save file.
